text:
[issue by HyperFIare]
### Bug Description

Basically everytime im on fire two stuck pixels appear on the right and left top ive tried everything to fix it and first ive deleted every single mod and installed all of them on by one (same for the resource pack) and the problem didnt appear except when i added sodium back that made the problem appear again on my screen and it even happens on the latest version 0.6.13 of sodium. I also tested my hardware using different monitors and cables and the issue still persists.

### Reproduction Steps

You can reproduce this Bug by installing sodium and making your own character catch on fire and that makes the stuck pixels appear near the right and left top corner of your screen
